name: opencode-cli-mcp
description: MCP server wrapping the opencode CLI (opencode serve) for AI agent orchestration: launch/poll/cancel agent runs, inspect and steer sessions, offline session depot over the opencode SQLite DB, MCPB bundle installs, and graceful shutdown.

tools.name: opencode_runs
tools.description: Agent run lifecycle: start (fire-and-forget or blocking), status, list, cancel

tools.name: opencode_sessions
tools.description: Session inspection and steering: list, get, messages, send, diff, grep, export

tools.name: opencode_depot
tools.description: Offline session depot over the opencode SQLite DB: list, get, archive, unarchive, rename, delete, search, stats

tools.name: opencode_system
tools.description: Environment and fleet: status, providers, project, launch_ui, mcp_pulse, config_drift

tools.name: opencode_mcpb_install
tools.description: Install .mcpb bundles into opencode config (dry-run support)
